kafka-connect:write-insert:v2.notes: Appends Kafka records to Iceberg tables with exactly-once delivery: workers write data files and a coordinator commits them atomically over a control topic.
caveats: Commits happen on an interval (default 5 minutes), so data lands in batches rather than per record
Exactly-once needs Kafka 2.5+ (KIP-447)

kafka-connect:write-merge-update-delete:.notes: Not supported. The sink only appends. Its task writers (UnpartitionedWriter and PartitionedAppendWriter) expose only write(record), the sink has no CDC or upsert setting, and nothing in it issues a delete. The experimental DebeziumTransform and DmsTransform only add _cdc.* metadata columns to records.
caveats: CDC records arrive as new rows carrying _cdc.op metadata; a downstream engine has to apply them
id-columns configure the writer factory but the append writers do not emit deletes

kafka-connect:merge-on-read:v2.notes: Not applicable: the sink never writes delete files, so it has no merge-on-read mode.

kafka-connect:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Not supported as a write operation. RecordUtils configures an equality-delete writer factory when id-columns are set, but the task writers built from it are append-only, so no equality delete file is produced.
caveats: id-columns / default-id-columns do not result in deletes

kafka-connect:position-deletes:v2.notes: The sink writes no position delete files.

kafka-connect:table-creation:v2.notes: iceberg.tables.auto-create-enabled=true creates missing destination tables (and namespaces) from the record schema; iceberg.tables.auto-create-props.* sets properties on the new table and partition-by sets its partitioning.
caveats: Off by default

kafka-connect:schema-evolution:v2.notes: iceberg.tables.evolve-schema-enabled=true adds record fields the table is missing as new columns, widens types, and (with schema-force-optional) relaxes columns to optional before writing.
caveats: Adds columns and widens int to long and float to double only; no drops or renames
Off by default

kafka-connect:type-promotion:v2.notes: Only two promotions are applied: int to long and float to double (SchemaUtils.needsDataTypeUpdate). Other type changes are not handled.

kafka-connect:table-maintenance:v2.notes: The sink does not compact files, expire snapshots or remove orphan files. It writes new files each commit interval, so small-file maintenance has to run elsewhere (Spark, Trino, or the catalog's own optimisation).

kafka-connect:branching-tagging:v2.notes: iceberg.tables.default-commit-branch and iceberg.table.<name>.commit-branch commit to a named branch instead of main, which supports write-audit-publish. The sink does not manage branches or tags beyond choosing the commit target.

kafka-connect:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: partition-by accepts year, month, day, hour, bucket and truncate transforms (or identity) when the sink creates a table, and PartitionedAppendWriter applies the table's partition spec, transforms included, to every record it writes.
caveats: Transforms are configured only at auto-create; existing tables keep their own spec

kafka-connect:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Any Iceberg catalog through iceberg.catalog.*: REST, Glue, DynamoDB, Hadoop and Nessie are bundled, Hive needs the Hive distribution, and other catalogs load through catalog-impl (a BigQuery Metastore example is documented).

kafka-connect:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: A Glue example is documented: set iceberg.catalog.catalog-impl to org.apache.iceberg.aws.glue.GlueCatalog with S3FileIO.

kafka-connect:rest-catalog:v2.notes: A REST catalog example is documented (iceberg.catalog.type=rest with uri, credential and warehouse), including ADLS and GCS warehouses.

kafka-connect:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

kafka-connect:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: The sink writes no deletion vectors; it never deletes rows.

kafka-connect:variant-type:v2.notes: V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

kafka-connect:variant-type:v3.notes: RecordConverter converts Kafka Connect values, including maps and structs, into the Iceberg VARIANT type for columns declared as variant.
caveats: Writing variant needs a V3 table

kafka-connect:shredded-variant:v2.notes: V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

kafka-connect:shredded-variant:v3.notes: Added in Iceberg 1.12.0: set write.parquet.shred-variants on the table and the sink writes variant data as shredded Parquet columns.
caveats: Parquet only
